messages:
carlos: Heads-up — getting a sudden spike of 429s from prod-pool-eu1 starting ~10:15 UTC. Incidence: SDK retries stacking and some frontends timing out. Anyone touching admission logic?
asha: I rolled a small tweak to admission windowing at 10:05 (reduce max-in-flight by 10%). Could be related. Seeing more 429s on long-context requests. :thinking:
carlos: Stack traces/headers from a failed request (from a client in eu-west):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1
X-Admission-Window: 0
X-Capacity-Hint: 0/64
Content-Type: application/json
```
Clients are not backing off enough — retries hit the edge again.
devon: We also changed pool-fill threshold on eu1 to be more conservative; that should reduce head-of-line but could make the admission window oscillate faster. If clients immediately retry the same way, we amplify the tail.
megan: Can we add a small randomized jitter to SDK retry backoff and also honor `X-Admission-Window` in the client? Right now SDK only respects `Retry-After` and ignores custom headers.
asha: Agree. The admission window header is intended to be a soft hint: when `X-Admission-Window: 0` the client should slow down and add jitter. We expected the SDK to interpret it but apparently the older SDK doesn't.
sdk-ci: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/472 — adds honor for `X-Admission-Window`, randomized jitter (uniform 0-250ms) on retries, and exponential backoff cap. Tests added.
ops-bot: deploy-bot pushed canary of previous admission tweak 10:05 -> service/eu1 v2.3.7-canary-1% at 10:12 UTC
carlos: Good. For immediate mitigation can we make the gateway include `Retry-After` bigger (2-4s) temporarily? Current 1s is too short given queueing.
devon: We can increase `Retry-After` at the gateway for eu1 to 3s for the next 20m. Patch queued.
megan: Also recommend emitting a telemetry flag `client_honors_admit_header` we can sample from SDKs — need to know how many clients ignore it.
asha: I'll add a temporary metric on the admission controller: count of requests where `X-Admission-Window=0` and a follow-up request from same client arrives within 1s.
carlos: Filing a short postmortem ticket: JR-1289. Include timeline + SDK PR link + migration guidance for partners. Can we also add a one-liner in the status page? customers may see errors.
devon: Patch to gateway and metric added. Rolling `Retry-After: 3` now. Will monitor.
sdk-ci: CI green on PR 472. Requesting review from @megan and @asha.
megan: Reviewing now. After merge let's cut an SDK point release and send a short changelog blurb to partners.
carlos: For next steps: 1) monitor 429 rate for 15m; 2) cut SDK release if rate drops; 3) if not resolved, revert admission change. Agreed?
asha: Agreed. Standing by to revert if 429s persist. :eyes:
ops-bot: metric-alert: prod-pool-eu1 429-rate down from 0.9% -> 0.12% in last 5m (since Retry-After bump). No further action yet.
carlos: Closing loop here — looks like increasing `Retry-After` + SDK patch should prevent immediate re-amplification. Follow-up: standardize `X-Admission-Window` semantics in SDK spec doc and add an example in README.
